entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: A vampire lord ruling the Dark Barony on Ulgrotha from Castle Sengir; progenitor of the Sengir vampires.

entities.name: Ravi
entities.description: An orphan girl who helped Sengir kill his father and was later freed from a coffin as a mad crone, becoming his teacher of black magic.

entities.name: Irini Sengir
entities.description: The dwarven king's daughter kidnapped and turned into a vampire by Sengir.

entities.name: Sengir's father
entities.description: A small baron who dabbled in black magic and pursued immortality via vampirism; killed by plague rats.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker on Ulgrotha who helps the Homelands resist Sengir.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Planeswalker who with Serra opposes Sengir; his grave is later marked by a tree Sengir plants.

entities.name: Eron
entities.description: Immortal King of the Goblins who makes a deal with Sengir.

entities.name: Lord Ihsan
entities.description: A Serra paladin who tried to kill Sengir and was made a shade and faithful servant.

entities.name: Veldrane
entities.description: Sengir's faithful hunter who stalks the wood for the Autumn Willow.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker who in BOOM! Comics summoned Sengir and later bound him in a pocket dimension.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker who visited Ulgrotha on the eve of the Great Mending.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane where Sengir was stranded and made his home.

entities.name: Dark Barony
entities.description: Sengir's barony of villages around a graveyard on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Castle Sengir
entities.description: A dwarven castle Sengir seized as his seat.

entities.name: Dwarven Gate
entities.description: A planar portal in the dwarven city under the castle.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Human land that Sengir terrorizes and manipulates.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: A presence in the Great Wood hostile to Sengir.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: Event in 4500 AR that weakens planeswalkers.

events.summary: Sengir's father tries to become an immortal through black magic and vampirism, bringing his son along.
events.quote: The baron intended to become an immortal and he had begun the path towards vampirism, bringing with him his son.

events.summary: Young Sengir and the orphan Ravi lead plague rats against the baron; the rats kill the boy and the baron, and Sengir revives as a vampire.
events.quote: However, he was visibly hurt by the sunlight and receded to a dark corner of the room, hinting at his now complete transformation into a vampire.

events.summary: Centuries later Sengir is summoned during a planeswalker duel and stranded on Ulgrotha.
events.quote: Centuries later, Baron Sengir was summoned during a planeswalker duel on Ulgrotha.

events.summary: Sengir slaughters the dwarves of the Castle of Morning Light and kidnaps the king's daughter, renaming her Irini Sengir.
events.quote: He turned her into a vampire, charming her to love him like a father and renaming her Irini Sengir .

events.summary: Sengir frees the mad crone Ravi from a sealed coffin in the Dead Zone and names her Grandmother Sengir.
events.quote: In any case, the baron quickly sensed the magical prowess of the woman and he brought her to his castle , renaming her Grandmother Sengir .

events.summary: Sengir sends vampires against Aysen and enslaves kidnapped humans in the Dark Barony.
events.quote: He instigated firm rules: if one person tried to flee the Barony, he would murder ten people in their place.

events.summary: Sengir meets Serra and Feroz and warns them not to interfere.
events.quote: After the arrival of Feroz , the Baron met the two planeswalkers and invited them to his castle.

events.summary: Sengir makes a deal with Eron, King of the Goblins.
events.quote: So, the two worked out a deal

events.summary: Sengir turns Lord Ihsan into a shade and servant instead of a vampire.
events.quote: he made him into a shade and faithful servant.

events.summary: After Feroz's death, Sengir reprimands Serra, who leaves Ulgrotha.
Leshrac sees Sengir's vampire army march through the Dwarven Gate on the eve of the Great Mending.
events.quote: The Baron was last seen at the head of this army, walking through the Dwarven Gate .

events.summary: In BOOM! Comics, Sorin Markov binds Sengir in a pocket dimension with obelisks.
events.quote: so he erected obelisks in the dwarven city and bound him in a pocket dimension, along with the dwarven vampires.

relations.quote: The infamous Baron Sengir is a vampire lord, ruling the Dark Barony on Ulgrotha from Castle Sengir .
He turned her into a vampire, charming her to love him like a father

relations.note: As Grandmother Sengir she taught him black magic.
relations.quote: She became his teacher of black magic, wisdom, and lost knowledge.

relations.note: Made a shade and faithful servant.
relations.quote: he made him into a shade and faithful servant.

relations.note: Helped the Homelands to repel him.
relations.quote: Serra and Feroz didn't agree with him and started to help the peoples of the Homelands to develop, to be better able to repel the Baron.

relations.note: BOOM! Comics: summoned him to Ulgrotha.
relations.quote: Sengir was summoned to Ulgrotha by by Sorin Markov
His faithful hunter Veldrane endlessly stalks the wood, searching for the fabled grove of Autumn Willow.
